permission_denials.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, sys, json, datetime
try:
    import yaml
except ImportError:
    print("no pyyaml"); sys.exit(0)
text = open("journals/2026-08-24-routine-handover-check.md").read()
fm = text.split("---\n")[1]
core = yaml.safe_load(fm)
schema = json.load(open(".claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json"))
try:
    import jsonschema
    # yaml parses date-times as datetime objects; stringify for format check
    def norm(o):
        if isinstance(o, dict): return {k: norm(v) for k, v in o.items()}
        if isinstance(o, list): return [norm(v) for v in o]
        if isinstance(o, datetime.datetime): return o.isoformat()
        return o
    jsonschema.validate(norm(core), schema, format_checker=jsonschema.FormatChecker())
    print("schema: OK")
except ImportError:
    print("no jsonschema; shape not checked by lib")
ev = {e["id"] for e in core["evidence"]}
refs = set()
for h in core["hypotheses"]:
    refs |= set(h["evidence_for"]) | set(h["evidence_against"])
for l in core.get("latent_findings", []):
    refs |= set(l["evidence"])
print("unresolved refs:", refs - ev)
print("unreferenced evidence:", ev - refs)
s, c = core["investigation"]["started"], core["investigation"]["concluded"]
print("wall clock:", (c - s).total_seconds(), "declared:", core["usage"]["wall_clock_seconds"])
print("verdict:", core["verdict"], "root_cause present:", "root_cause" in core)
EOF
